amendment.general_amendment_mechanism: GovernanceAmendment object (crates/types/src/shielded_bridge_governance.rs:2011-2034) with quorum, support, activation_height, veto_until_height fields; activation is per-kind and height-based (latest committed wins for fee/memo gates; earliest unpaused height wins for recipient format); no single global majority threshold and no time-based supermajority rule exists
amendment.governed_amendment_threshold: registry threshold floor(2n/3)+1 of the active validator set
amendment.veto_procedure: No veto procedure is specified beyond the veto_until_height field on the amendment object

devnet.blocks: on demand only — height does not advance with wall-clock time (docs/status/network-status.md:55-56)

genesis.construction: G0 = Selected intersect Receipted from a frozen Dynamic UNL round on the fork; ML-DSA-65 identity receipts; domain-separated SHA-256 payload hash; certificate of >= q_S signatures
genesis.supply_note: Total supply 100B PFT fixed (decided 2026-10-28); the ERC-20 slice size is open; genesis gives the faucet the native supply minus the lanes' reserved_atoms
genesis.supply_partition: Whitepaper section 1.3: s_native + s_shielded + s_external + s_in-flight = s_authorized

ledger_close.close_cadence_note: No block time, slot duration, or ledger-close cadence is specified in the pinned l1v2 docs or code surveyed; the devnet makes blocks only when transactions are pending

mainnet_date_note: No official mainnet/TGE date is published in the surveyed sources; the word TGE does not appear in docs/, README.md or roadmap.md
note: Specification-derived expectations for postfiatl1v2 (Consensus v2). Every entry cites the pinned file and line. Where the specification defines no value, the entry is null and the scenario stays UNVERIFIED — never inferred.

validation.commit_rule: q distinct precommit votes for the same non-nil block form the only commit QC; a prepare QC of q votes is the durable lock
validation.lifetime_note: No wall-clock validity window is specified; votes persist under the durable round floor until superseded by a higher round (docs/architecture/consensus-signing-rounds.md)
